idea-plugin.name: ticketmasta
idea-plugin.description:
ticketmasta is a coding plugin that lets you work on your project's GitHub issues without leaving the IDE.

It adds a right-side tool window that lists your repository's open GitHub issues (private repositories supported via a personal access token), renders a selected issue with its overview, and gives you a Markdown editor where Scaffold AI diagnoses the issue against your codebase and drafts a TODO.md implementation plan you can save to the project root or hand to an external agent (opencode) via Send to AI. AI provider (OpenAI or OpenRouter), model, and credentials are configured in Settings > Tools > TicketMasta.
